description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BitsStreamGenerator' for random number generator implementations that generate streams of bits and various primitive data types. It provides core methods and utilities for generating pseudorandom booleans, bytes, doubles, floats, integers, longs, and Gaussian-distributed doubles, while defining abstract seed setting and core bit generation methods to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: BitsStreamGenerator
classes.description: An abstract base class for random number generators that produce bit streams and primitive data types, supporting seed setting, bit generation, and various random data methods.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Abstract method to set the seed with an integer array.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Abstract method to set the seed with a long integer.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Abstract method to set the seed with an integer.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the next 'bits' random bits.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills the provided byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextDouble
methods.description: Generates a pseudorandom double in the [0,1) interval.

methods.name: nextFloat
methods.description: Generates a pseudorandom float in the [0,1) interval.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a Gaussian-distributed pseudorandom number using the Box-Muller transform, caching the second value for efficiency.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a pseudorandom int in [0, n) using rejection sampling for uniformity.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a pseudorandom long in [0, n) using rejection sampling.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal caches used by Gaussian number generation.
